Dockage / Foreign Material (FM)
Dockage is all material other than wheat that can be easily removed with either a mechanical dockage tester or appropriate size hand sieve.
Foreign Material (FM) is all matter other than wheat that remains in the sample after the removal of dockage and shrunken and broken kernels.
All dockage and foreign material are deducted from the gross weight with a minimum of 0.5%.
